Cappuccino Cookie (Korean: 카푸치노맛 쿠키, kapuchinomat kuki) is an Epic Cookie released alongside his Pet, Creamy Cappuccino, in the second half of the Face the Trial! update.

Story

From the Bear Jelly over consumption incident to the art theft at the Hors d'Oeuvre Museum, all the century's major criminal cases have been handled by none other than the veteran prosecutor, Cappuccino Cookie!

Though he's a veteran beyond doubt, he constantly mumbles about being tired. However, Cappuccino Cookie's commitment to justice remains unwavering, evident when he tirelessly stacks cappuccino-filled cups while interrogating suspects throughout the night.

Once the trials are over, he plans on going on vacation and this is why he wears a vacation shirt underneath his robe. But when will that day truly come?!

Affection Jelly

Whenever feeling worn out, it pins its desired travel destination on the world map.

Skill

Cappuccino Cookie's Skill
When you collect a certain number of Evidence Jellies, you will enter a courtroom. Once in the courtroom, a board will appear where you can submit the evidence collected. Adjust your jump according to the height of the boards and tap the button to attach the evidence. Once all boards have been attached with evidence, the judge will examine the evidence and make a ruling. The higher the level, the higher the Evidence Points and Verdict Points.

Quotes

New

  • I wish all Cookies were good... I could use a break.

General

  • Yeah, yeah... See you in court.
  • Even with all this evidence, are you still going to deny it?
  • You should start admitting the crime you committed.
  • It doesn't hurt to be nice and honest to one another, you know?
  • It is my job to make justice prevail.
  • Once this trial is over, I'm definitely taking a vacation...!
  • The list of vacation destinations just keeps getting longer...
  • Facing consequences for wrongdoing is common sense, right?
  • I stayed up all night, again...
  • Since the trial tomorrow is crucial, there's nothing I can do about it.

Tired

  • I need a vacation...

Cookie Trial

  • Where is that file?! The trial is tomorrow!
  • This might be harder than you think!
  • Are you staying up all night, too? How about a cup of cappuccino then?
  • Remember, this job can get very draining.
  • Let's keep in mind that we work for justice.
  • Don't burn yourself out by working too hard from the start.

Lobby

Daily Gift

  • Something to make your day!

Tap

  • With all the cappuccino cups I've had, I could build a courthouse pillar.
  • A question I ask to every new prosecutor: What do you think justice is?

  • I put the documents somewhere in the office... it's like finding a needle in a haystack...
  • I have a lot of memorable trials. Not all are pleasant memories, though...
  • Once I retire, I might consider working part-time at my favorite café...
  • Looks like pulling an all-nighter is something I can't do anymore...
  • Hey, how did that case go?
  • It's not like I want to keep taking on cases without a break, you know.
  • I feel the proudest when bad Cookies pay for their crimes.

Changelog

  • Face the Trial! - August 11, 2023
    • Added to the game as a playable Cookie alongside a Costume,  Sunburnt Surfer.
  • Face the Trial! - July 28, 2023

Trivia

  • According to the Google Play Store promotional section for his release, Cappuccino Cookie wears shorts underneath his robe, ready to go on vacation on a moment's notice.
  • During Cappuccino Cookie's gameplay preview[1], “gavel” was accidentally misspelled as “gravel”.
